EXPLANATORY

NOTE

Raw materials like coal, ore, lime stone, etc, are supplied to steel plant, thermal power station The contents of the railway wagons and other similar industries through open railway wagons. are emptied at industrial units through the use of wagon tipplers. For optimum utilization of wagon tipplers, wagons are placed and removed from wagon tipplers with the use of marshalling equip-. ment. Marshalling equipment viz. Beetle trolley type/Continuous wire rope type are used for inhauling/outhauling of the wagons on unloading/loading tracks as also for correct placement/ spotting of wagons at the desired position. 7

38:10464-1963
The wagon marshalling equipment used in conjunction with wagon tipplers operates either in With a view to minimize the damage to between the railway tracks or by the side of the tracks. either the railway equipment or the marshalling equipment, it is desired that the marshalling equipment is designed and placed in a manner that it does not interfere with the normal operation The Research Design & Standards of railway wagons or other equipment on the railway track. Organization ( Ministry of Railways), Lucknow, therefore, desires that all the wagons marshalling equipment when passing below or alongside the wagon shall be out of the limiting gauge profile of the wagon given in Fig. 1.

This standard lays down the data required for selection of wagon puller /pusher ( wagon and purchasers alike marshalling equipment ). This data sheet may be utilized by manufacturers to enable them to select the equipment according to their requirements.
